what: Proposed ship_pr_with_transient_retry loses exhausted rc=0 transient-envelope terminal semantics
scenario_or_breakage: The plan moves exhaustion into lib-net.sh as return _WTR_RC, then the proposed ship-pr wrapper returns immediately when _WTR_RC is 0. If ci-wait.sh or merge-pr.sh emits an ACTION=bail or MERGE_RESULT=error transient envelope on all three attempts while exiting 0, the lifted helper retries but returns 0 after the final attempt; ship-pr then accepts success instead of the original exit_transient_net path.
suggested_fix: Have the lifted helper expose final transient-exhausted state, for example _WTR_TRANSIENT_EXHAUSTED=1, and make ship_pr_with_transient_retry check that before the rc=0 short-circuit. Keep predicate evaluation inside with_transient_retry, and add a ship-pr or lib-net test for rc=0 plus matching custom predicate on all three attempts.
